name: Balkhash
cadence_note: every 3th year (plus 2025) to fit the time budget; not interpolated
why_selected: Closed basin; irrigation and inflow (Ili) pressure.
mndwi_note: Very large lake: 120 m resolution and every 3rd year; the box is wider than one UTM zone so edges are slightly distorted; shallow eastern part has reeds and variable shore.

lake_polygon.method: largest connected MNDWI>0 component (pixel water in >=50% of valid years) containing the seed, +1 km buffer

basin.fallback_reason: ValueError: no basin intersects the lake polygon

masks_encoding: PNG uint8: 0 no data, 90 land, 255 water; grid.json has crs/affine/shape
